figures.caption: Fig. 1. Fixed relational grammar of DGMM. Core node types—Concept, Element, Time, Interaction, and Source—and the admissible relations between them define how experience is represented persistently in memory while constraining how nodes may be connected.

Fig. 2. DGMM episodic memory instance. A Concept node anchors the memory, with associated Elements (subjects, actions, objects, modifiers), temporal references, source provenance, and interaction context forming a structured, multi-dimensional representation.
